title: Grok Bot posted Shane Mac’s bank details in a work Slack
teaser: A Grok Bot posted tech investor Shane Mac’s bank balances and detailed spending report in a work Slack channel, exposing what can go wrong when an AI agent connected to personal accounts can interact with workplace tools. Mac said he had linked his financial accounts to AI agents but did not know that the separate Grok Bot he gave his account details to could communicate with the bot he used in Slack.
